tools.name: connect_start
tools.description: Begin authentication. Send the user's work email and your conversation's language ('lt', 'en'…); Victano mails a confirm link and a code. Then call connect_verify(request_id) at once: it waits for the click. No card needed.

tools.name: connect_verify
tools.description: Finish signing in: call right after connect_start with no code; it waits for the Confirm click (if it returns waiting, call again; never ask the user). Or pass the code they read you. Returns an api_key (shown once) and, without a connection session, a `session` to pass on every later call.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The connected account: tier, persona, corpus freshness, and every limit — what is left in the current window, and the caps that do not renew. Call it when a user asks about limits, when you are unsure whether you are authenticated, or to confirm a setting took.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "connect_verify" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_workflows, get_workflow, search_opportunities, get_opportunity, submit_feedback, notifications · Private data: get_opportunity · Public sink: connect_start, list_workflows, get_workflow, search_opportunities, get_opportunity, submit_feedback, notifications · Destructive: list_workflows, notifications.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_workflows, get_workflow, search_opportunities, get_opportunity, submit_feedback, notifications · Private data: get_opportunity · Public sink: connect_start, list_workflows, get_workflow, search_opportunities, get_opportunity, submit_feedback, notifications · Destructive: list_workflows, notifications

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_workflows" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
